item.title: Why Your Anonymous Survey Isn't Anonymous
item.description:
Why Your “Anonymous” Survey Isn’t Anonymous A data ethics analysis of anonymity, trust, and student survey design

Ever had that weird feeling when a survey says “anonymous” but then asks you to log in?

That happened to me this week while looking at a case study for our Ethics class at Trios College. Students get a link to rate their course. The page says, “All answers will remain anonymous.” But to open it, you must type your college username and password.
